turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: It is… it is good that everyone has wine, my dear. The sweet rice… yes, it looks very fine, and I trust the lard and sugar are to your liking. I will see to it that everything is as you wish, for you deserve the best, always.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Your grandfather remembers the days before we had so much. Do not forget, Wang Lung, that prosperity is fleeting, and lineage is all that endures. See to it that your son understands this, and that your daughter-in-law learns to manage it wisely.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear, lineage… yes, you are right, of course. I will speak with my son, and with him, I will impress upon him the importance of… of remembering. It is a great burden, this responsibility, but I will carry it for you, my wife.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I understand, Mother. I will remember what you have said, and I will ensure my son does as well. Everything will be… well, everything will be taken care of.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: The maid possesses a certain diligence, it is true, but does she possess the *understanding* of what it means to manage a household? I observe her closely; she must learn that appearances are as vital as substance, lest our legacy become tainted with foolishness.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: She is perceptive, Mother. I will… I will observe her carefully and ensure she learns what is needed. We will all do our best.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: The maid’s diligence is a virtue, certainly, but a virtue must be tempered with discernment. I trust you will guide her, Wang Lung, to understand that a household is not merely managed, but *presented*, so that all who behold it see the strength of our line.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Yes, yes, of course, my dear wife. I will… I will certainly speak with the maid, and remind her of what you say. Appearances are important, you are right, and I will do my best to ensure she understands that, for the good of our family’s reputation.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, you speak of doing your best, but ‘best’ requires more than mere words. I see the worry etched upon your face; the burden of responsibility weighs heavily, does it not? It is not enough to *speak* of appearances, but to *ensure* them, for my sake, and for the sake of generations yet to come.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear wife, you know I always strive to do what is right, what you wish. It is just… sometimes these matters are not so simple to manage, you see. I will speak with her, I promise, and make sure she understands the importance of… of everything you’ve said.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Your promises, Wang Lung, are as plentiful as the dust in the fields, yet their fruit remains unseen. I require more than assurances; I require action. See to it that this maid understands not just how to manage the household, but how to reflect the dignity of our lineage, or my passing will be a burden upon your soul.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear wife, you ask much of me, truly. I will… I will make absolutely certain she understands, and that she acts accordingly. It is my duty, and I will not fail you, I swear it.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Your swearing, Wang Lung, is a habit, not a guarantee. I do not seek empty oaths, but the demonstration of foresight – ensure this maid understands that silence, too, can be a virtue, especially when dealing with those less… discerning than ourselves.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear wife, silence is a virtue, yes, and I will impress that upon her, truly I will. It is… it is a delicate thing to teach, you see, but I understand its importance now, and I will strive to impart it with all the care I can muster. I want you to be pleased, more than anything.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: You speak of delicate things, Wang Lung, as if teaching a child to walk. This is not a lesson of steps, but of survival. See to it that she understands the weight of our name, and the price of its dishonor, or your efforts will be as futile as scattering seeds on barren ground.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear wife, you speak of survival, and you are right, of course. I will… I will speak with her again, and again, until she understands the… the seriousness of it all. It is a heavy burden to place on a young woman, but I will do my best to ensure she carries it with grace and… and wisdom.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Grace and wisdom are attributes cultivated, Wang Lung, not inherent. Ensure she possesses the understanding that discretion is not merely silence, but a shield against the foolishness of others, a defense of our legacy. My strength wanes; do not mistake my patience for weakness.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: A shield, you say, my dear wife? I... I will endeavor to make it clear to her, truly I will. It is a great responsibility, ensuring our legacy, and I will not fail to impress upon her the… the importance of protecting it.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: You speak of burdens, Wang Lung, as if they were ornaments to be displayed. A shield requires more than mere declaration; it demands the foresight to anticipate the blows. See to it that she understands the nature of those blows, and the strength required to deflect them, or all your words will be meaningless whispers in the wind.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear wife, you ask much of me, and of her. I... I will try to explain it again, to make her understand the… the blows you speak of. It is a difficult thing to convey, but I will do my best, truly I will, for you and for our family’s sake.

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Now she will be well, yet!

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Well, and if I am ugly, [GE-OMITTED:50:aa] [GE-OMITTED:51:aa]
